summary: No installer-side threat observed in litespeed-cache@1.1.1
details: No malicious behavior was observed in this package version. There is no lifecycle script (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) executing at install time, no top-level import-time network activity, no credential or filesystem reads targeting installer secrets, and no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations. The package name resembles the LiteSpeed Cache WordPress plugin ecosystem, which is a naming concern worth noting but is not by itself a supply-chain threat under this system's threat model.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
